R/ VICTORIA[E] LAETAE PRINC PERP ; D/ IMP CONSTA-NTINVS AVG

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I, AD 306-337 (Reece period 16). Reverse legend reads VICTORIA[E] LAETAE PRINC PERP. Reverse shows Two Victories holding wreath, inscribed VOT PR, above altar. Mint is Arles, AD 319. RIC VII, p. 255, no. 191. Obverse legend reads IMP CONSTA-NTINVS AVG. Obverse shows a laureate and helmeted, cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue reads: -//PARL.…
